author: Myshqipez
quote: Honestly, this game is massively overrated. The graphics feel outdated, the performance is disappointing, and the gameplay gets repetitive very quickly. The world is big, but that doesn’t automatically make it interesting. It feels like people praise it simply because it’s Zelda. Nowhere near the masterpiece some people claim it is. Definitely not GOTY material.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Myshqipez
quote: GTA 6 is already GOTY material.Rockstar has once again raised the bar for the entire gaming industry. The level of detail, the world design, the characters, the atmosphere and the storytelling look absolutely incredible. This isn’t just another open-world game; it’s a new standard for what video games can achieve. GTA 6 has the potential to be one of the greatest games ever made. Game of the Year without a doubt. Rockstar is on another level.
